rapport_notes: Casual, friendly; handled a price-shopping customer with honesty rather than pressure.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if the move goes faster... you pay less" (pay-less concept hit) — other Save Your Ass lines not covered.

top_strength: When the customer admitted he wanted to shop around, the rep didn't get defensive — just booked with no-penalty flexibility, the right no-pressure approach for a price-shopping customer.
coaching_note: On-Time Guarantee and Meet-Your-Mover were skipped entirely in this call — worth double-checking the standard differentiator block stays a habit even in fast, casual-feeling calls.
